name: consensus_wo_decide-s60-r1
cmd: GDP_ENUM_LOG=1 GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 90 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only consensus_wo_decide --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/err.log; s=$?; grep -E 'small instance|enum t. (set|engine end|view|caller|diagram view)|join (template|enumerated|end|failed)|^.infer. (kernel|end)' /tmp/err.log | cut -c1-400 | head -c 12000; exit $s
